sn.c: The Mezzanine overhang starts at Orchestra row H and drops into the stage by row N.
sn.sh: Overhang drops into the stage by row N

sn.c: A Box to the left offers an angled view, while a Box to the side of the Right Orchestra offers slightly side-on views.
sn.sh: Boxes offer angled or slightly side-on views

sn.c: The far sides of the Mezzanine are among the cheapest seat locations.
sn.sh: Cheapest seats include the far sides

sn.c: The Orchestra has much better legroom than the average Broadway venue, with better legroom on aisle seats.
Legroom is usually better than average in the Mezzanine.

vs.sum: Completed a major renovation in early 2026 with all seats replaced and legroom expanded, making it one of Broadway's most comfortable and modern houses. New restrooms significantly reduce intermission wait times.

acc.note: Elevators to all levels. 53 assistive listening devices. 11 wheelchair seats across Orchestra and Balcony.
